title: Evaluation of a term with a leading literal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $l$ be a literal on $n$ variables, let $t$ be a list of literals on those variables, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to the variables. The term formed by placing $l$ at the beginning of $t$ evaluates at $x$ to the conjunction of the value of $l$ at $x$ and the evaluation of $t$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is a list of literals on $n$ variables
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to $n$ variables
